verdict.rationale: Muse's first-party docs say you can link your email and calendar and control what the agent can see and do, and that it manages email for you. There is no documented cloud-drive connector; the only route is Muse writing its own custom connector for services that have APIs or CLIs. missing for 10: a native cloud-drive connector, explicit evidence that the assistant searches connected email, calendar or drive content to ground its answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the connectors.
